summary: @or-sdk/adapters preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares itself as a small OneReach adapters SDK, but its `preinstall` script invokes `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then runs the bundled `math_init.js` under Bun via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style file (shuffled `n7gIxM` string/int array with a `WV8StW` rotator, `_0xNNNN` identifiers). `setup.mjs` itself is similarly obfuscated to hide the download-extract-exec flow. Executing an opaque obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime at install time evades Node-based static analysis; neither the Bun download nor the payload is hash-/signature-verified. The obfuscation, the runtime-swap execution path, and the mismatch between the declared adapters-SDK purpose and a 727KB obfuscated 'math_init' sibling are jointly consistent with an install-time dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
